description: This file generates and manages Swagger API documentation for a NestJS application, including grouping paths by tags, formatting, and setting up documentation endpoints.

methods.name: generateSwaggerForApp
methods.description: Generates Swagger documentation for the app, groups paths by first tag, writes to file, and sets up Swagger UI endpoint.

methods.name: groupAndSortPathsByFirstTag
methods.description: Groups API paths by their first tag and sorts the tags according to custom rules.

methods.name: customTagSort
methods.description: Custom sorting function for tags, prioritizing 'Platform' and 'Orgs' prefixes.

methods.name: isOperationObject
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object is an OperationObject with tags.
